name: Intune Drive Mapping Generator
description: A web-based tool that generates PowerShell scripts for network drive mapping on Intune-managed Windows 10 devices. Converts existing Group Policy drive exports to Intune-compatible scripts, supports security group filtering with nested groups, and enables recurring execution.
author: Nicola Suter

securityCheck.aiSummary: Overall, the codebase uses standard Intune/PowerShell drive-mapping patterns and does not include direct credential theft or remote code execution from external URLs. However, the test PS1 contains persistence (scheduled task) and window-hiding techniques that can be misused for stealthy execution, and transcript logging that could leak sensitive data. Production-grade tooling should replace the stealth-windows launcher with transparent, auditable startup mechanisms and enforce strict logging controls. Validate file upload handling for security and ensure no execution occurs from uploaded content.

noMaliciousPatterns.reason: When executed with SYSTEM privileges the script creates a scheduled task to run on user logon, including a VBScript wrapper to hide the PowerShell window and invoke PowerShell with -ExecutionPolicy ByPass. This persistence pattern resembles malware techniques and should be guarded in production builds.
